item.description:
新增

  • 集合可以设置颜色，库中属于集合的卡片头部显示该颜色
  • 库和剪贴板中的文字、富文本、链接、颜色可以修改内容
  • 「库」菜单可以新建集合
  • 库中可以新建文本，入口在「库」菜单和管理窗口工具栏

改进

  • 库中的卡片不再显示来源 App 图标
  • 钉住到库的内容按加入库的时间排序，卡片显示加入时间
  • 重命名后卡片头部显示新名称

修复

  • 开启获取链接标题之前的链接，粘贴或钉住后不再联网获取

Added

  • Collections can have a color, shown on the header of their cards in the Library
  • Text, rich text, links and colors in the Library and Clipboard can be edited
  • New collections can be created from the Library menu
  • New text can be added to the Library from its menu or the management window

Changed

  • Cards in the Library no longer show the source app icon
  • Items pinned to the Library are sorted and dated by when they were added
  • A renamed item now shows its new name in the card header

Fixed

  • Links copied before title fetching was enabled are no longer fetched after pasting or pinning

新增

  • 新增类目列表和模型页，可自定义类目并手动整理类目
  • 确认「整理类目」后，会把最多 60 个条目的摘要发给通用模型

改进

  • 智能分类默认不再包含剪贴板，钉住到库的条目按库的范围分类

Added

  • Added Category List and Models pages, with custom categories
  • Suggest Categories sends up to 60 item summaries to your general model

Changed

  • Smart classification no longer includes the clipboard by default; pinned items follow the Library setting

新增

  • 智能分类设置新增「打开控制台」，可在浏览器中管理 API Key 和账单

改进

  • 精简设置页：已有条目的分类操作收成一行，检查更新移到版本号旁
  • 默认开启自动检查更新，可在「通用」设置中关闭

修复

  • 智能分类的「高级」现在点整行都能展开收起
  • 剪贴板图片在列表和存储空间页不再显示空名称

Added

  • Added Open Console to Smart Categories settings for managing API keys and billing

Changed

  • Tidied Settings: existing-item actions fit on one row and Check for Updates sits beside the version
  • Update checks are now on by default and can be turned off in General settings

Fixed

  • Advanced in Smart Categories settings now expands when you click anywhere on its row
  • Clipboard images no longer appear with a blank name in lists and Storage
